headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑flying performers and modest profit trends.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from modest double‑digit gains at Infosys and TCS to a standout 53.6% at Coforge. Profit growth was uneven, with Infosys up 6% YoY, HCLTech up 21%, but Wipro profit fell 1.9%. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys and introduced at HCLTech and Wipro. AI contributions were highlighted but quantified only at a few firms.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI as a growth driver, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed stable for most, but Wipro and OFSS showed volatility in constant‑currency growth.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Profit jumped 21% YoY, driven by strong AI revenue and solid top‑line growth.

laggards.why: Revenue grew only 1.5% YoY and profit growth slowed to 6%, with FY27 guidance cut.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and headcount declined.

domain_outlook.note: No company mentioned activity in this domain.
